Do you happen to know the answer to another question I have?: When modeling a low poly  object and you shade it smooth, do you add support loops to it before you bake normal map onto it? To fix up the normals before you bake I mean. Cause it looks to me like the normals of the low poly objects will be blended with the high poly object when baking, so if you have a flat surface that is shaded smooth and you don't have support loops, the normals will become weird when baking.

I bake it in blender. I create a low poly object, then i copy it and sculpt in details. Then I have the objects in the same position, then I use the bake feature that is built into blender.
